chunks: For those who deny the truth and obstruct (others) from the way of God, We shall add torment to torment as they were perpetrating corruption.
ai.seo_question: Why is the punishment increased for those who obstruct others from God's path?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Nahl highlights the principle of 'Zaydat al-'Adhab' (increase in punishment), where the severity of torment escalates proportionally to the degree of active corruption (ifsad) and obstruction of the divine path. It underscores that disbelief is not merely a passive state but an active impediment to others' guidance, warranting compounded retribution. This concept is often linked to the idea that those who mislead others bear the burden of their own sins plus the sins of those they misled.
